messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: prod-inference - error_rate > 5% across requests to /v1/generate for the last 3m. Severity: high. Please acknowledge in #incidents and follow the runbook: https://internal/runbooks/prod-inference

eve_sre: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs and checking routing policies.

rahul_oncall: i'm 5m out but can take initial triage. handing off to eve if you want full ownership. (reacted with :hand:)

carmen_prod: customer-facing note: two enterprise customers reported timeouts in their dashboards ~10:02. no public SLA impact reported yet but tickets are popping. pls keep updates short for support.

incident-bot: Auto-attach: recent deploy 2026-03-15T09:58Z by dmitri_eng (release/serve-optim). Deploy id: deploy-8973.

dmitri_eng: i rolled a kernel tweak last deploy that touches quantized path selection. i haven't seen anything in canary. pushing logs from the node group now.

eve_sre: quick reconnaissance: error is 5xx from runtime  | stack traces returning 'KVCache miss -> NullPointer' on some shards. however, sampling for request logs is 0.05. i can't confirm full request bodies. Observability gap: request body sampling too low for this codepath.

rahul_oncall: noted. i'm going to increase sampling to 1.0 for the affected service group and toggle debug-logs for the runtime on 3 hosts. doing that now:
```bash
# increase sampling and loglevel via controlplane api
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://controlplane/api/v1/configs/sampling -d '{"service":"inference-runtime","sample_rate":1.0}'
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/inference-runtime RUNTIME_LOGLEVEL=debug
```

eve_sre: thanks. while that propagates, sharing an ad-hoc query that showed error signatures across hosts.
```sql
-- quick query in metrics explorer
SELECT host, count(*) as errors
FROM logs
WHERE service = 'inference-runtime' AND status >= 500 AND timestamp > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY host
ORDER BY errors desc
```

obs-bot: Notice: log sampling change detected on inference-runtime from 0.05 -> 1.0 at 09:12:47 UTC. Dashboard panels will repopulate as logs arrive.

carmen_prod: support_alex, please hold a blameless customer update: "We're investigating a runtime error impacting some requests, increased logging and triage in progress. No data exfiltration. Will update in 30m or when we have mitigation."

support_alex: copying that to customers.

dmitri_eng: i see increased debug lines from two hosts but some hosts still show gaps — host group shard-7 is silent. looks like logging agent crashed on those nodes during the deploy. grabbing system logs.

eve_sre: and that aligns with timeline: deploy at 09:58, first customer reports 10:02, error spike 10:04. hypothesis 1: the new kernel selection path triggers a code path that exercises a previously unobserved branch, exposing an NPE when KVCache misses AND logging agent is absent -> makes debugging intermittent. hypothesis 2: networking flake caused partial failures and made caches inconsistent.

rahul_oncall: i'm building timeline notes here. pls add any concrete evidence as bullets so we can include in RCA later.
- 09:58 deploy-8973 (dmitri_eng)
- 10:02 first customer support ticket (carmen_prod)
- 10:04 metric spike: error_rate >5%
- 10:08 increased sampling to 1.0 (rahul_oncall)
- 10:10 discovered logging agent crash on shard-7 (dmitri_eng)

dmitri_eng: system logs from shard-7: "OOMKilled: logging-agent" followed by restart. looks like burst memory from debug bundle during rollout. attaching truncated logs: 
```
[shard-7] Mar 15 10:05:12 kubelet: Evicted container logging-agent due to memory pressure
[shard-7] Mar 15 10:05:12 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 3245 (logging-agent) score 987
[shard-7] Mar 15 10:06:01 kubelet: Started container logging-agent
```

eve_sre: that suggests a partial observability gap: while most hosts streamed full requests, shard-7 missed the period we need. we may need to rely on metrics, traces, and the hosts that did have logs. action: collect KV cache state dumps from runtime on affected hosts. dmitri, can you grab /var/lib/runtime/kvcache* and attach?

dmitri_eng: started collecting KV dumps and stack traces from hosts that had logs. uploading to /artifacts/incidents/1759123456. will paste relevant snippets here when available.

carmen_prod: do we have a mitigation to reduce customer impact now? any quick config rollback or fallback?

eve_sre: mitigation plan: 1) revert kernel selection tweak in controlplane to force previous quantized path (fast rollback). 2) increase autoscaler buffer for shard-7 group to avoid OOM during logging bursts. 3) temporary rate-limit noisy routes to reduce pressure. i'm going to trigger rollback for 1 now.

rahul_oncall: executing rollback command: 
```bash
controlplane releases rollback --id deploy-8973 --to-tag release/serve-optim@prev
```
(reacted with :white_check_mark:)

incident-bot: Rollback request acknowledged. Rollback in progress across 12 nodes. Expected completion ~10:18 UTC.

support_alex: passed tentative mitigation note to affected customers. they want ETA and root cause when known.

obs-bot: Dashboard note: we discovered two panels were mis-specified and were sampling 10x lower than intended (panel: runtime-requests-slow). suggest follow-up ticket to correct panel queries.

eve_sre: adding that to timeline under "observability gaps" and creating follow-up: OBS-342: correct panel sampling and add alert for logging-agent restarts.

dmitri_eng: KV dump snippet shows null pointer at lookup when key length == 0. patch incoming to add a guard; i'll open PR and we can hotfix after rollback if errors persist.

rahul_oncall: rollback completed at 10:18. error rate dropped to baseline ~0.3% by 10:22. customers reporting resumed normal traffic.

carmen_prod: good to confirm. support will close urgent tickets and keep them informed about RCA timeline.

eve_sre: final in-incident notes for RCA:
- Impact: elevated 5xx rates for ~18 minutes, two enterprise customers had failed requests. no data loss.
- Root-cause hypothesis (in order): (A) kernel selection tweak introduced a code path with missing guard for empty KV keys -> NPE on some runtime requests, (B) logging-agent OOM on shard-7 created observability blind spot making triage slower.
- Mitigations performed: rollback deploy-8973, increase sampling, restart logging agent, autoscaler buffer increase for shard group.
- Open follow-ups: OBS-342 (dashboards), INF-765 (guard against empty KV keys), SRE-901 (monitor logging-agent restarts + auto-restart policy).

dmitri_eng: i'll open INF-765 PR and link artifacts.

eve_sre: thanks all. i'll convert this thread into the incident timeline doc and start the RCA draft. please add any missing logs or notes. closing live mitigation channel in 10m unless something else pops up. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
